classes.name: ConfigurationProvider
classes.description: A PHP class that provides AWS endpoint configurations, supporting environment variable, ini file, and fallback sources, with caching and chaining capabilities.

methods.name: defaultProvider
methods.description: Creates a default configuration provider that checks environment variables, shared config files, and fallback options, with optional caching based on provided configuration.

methods.name: env
methods.description: Creates a configuration provider that sources its configuration from environment variables.

methods.name: ini
methods.description: Creates a configuration provider that sources its configuration from a specified ini file, defaulting to the standard AWS config location.

methods.description: Provides fallback configuration options when other sources are not set.
